questions.stem: In Part 1, how many times is each statement read?
choices: As many times as you press play
Only the correct one is repeated

fr.rule: Les énoncés de la Part 1 ne sont lus qu'une fois et ne sont pas imprimés.
why_wrong: A : chaque énoncé n'est lu qu'une fois.
B : il n'y a pas de bouton de lecture à l'examen.

en.rule: Part 1 statements are read only once and are not printed.
why_wrong: A: each statement is read only once.
B: there is no play button in the exam.

questions.stem: What is the best first step when a new photo appears?
choices: Skip the photo until the audio ends
Identify who is in the photo and what they are doing

fr.rule: Anticipez avant l'audio : qui, quoi, où.
why_wrong: A : on perd l'avantage de l'anticipation.
C : elles ne sont pas imprimées.

en.rule: Anticipate before the audio: who, what, where.
why_wrong: A: you lose the advantage of anticipation.

questions.stem: A statement mentions an object that does not appear in the photo. What should you do?
choices: Wait for the next statement and come back
Choose it if the verb is correct
Choose it if it sounds familiar

fr.rule: Un énoncé qui contient un élément absent est faux.
why_wrong: A : on ne peut pas revenir en arrière.
C : un objet absent rend l'énoncé faux.
D : la familiarité sonore est un piège.

en.rule: A statement that contains an absent element is wrong.
why_wrong: C: an absent object makes the statement wrong.
D: sound familiarity is a trap.

questions.stem: Which sentence describes a STATE rather than an action in progress?
choices: Boxes are stacked on a shelf.
A woman is lifting a box.

fr.rule: Le passif sans « being » décrit un état.

en.rule: A passive without 'being' describes a state.

questions.stem: Which pair of verbs are easily confused in Part 1?

fr.rule: Attention aux verbes d'apparence proche (wearing / trying on).

en.rule: Watch out for look-alike verbs (wearing / trying on).
